config.description: The section header for the configuration file

endpoint_url.description: S3 endpoint host. Used for access_host if endpoint_url is not provided.

access_key.description: AWS Access Key ID. Empty string disables static key config if not passed via args.

secret_key.description: AWS Secret Access Key. Empty string disables static key config if not passed via args.

num_threads.description: Number of concurrent threads for S3 operations.

retry.description: Number of retries before giving up on a failed operation.

multipart_split_size.description: Size in bytes to split multipart transfers (default 15MB).

max_singlepart_download_size.description: Max file size in bytes for singlepart downloads.

max_singlepart_upload_size.description: Max file size in bytes for singlepart uploads.

max_singlepart_copy_size.description: Max file size in bytes for singlepart copies.

batch_delete_size.description: Number of files (<1000) to be combined in batch delete.

user_canonical_name.description: Canonical name for the user (for ACLs).

user_canonical_id.description: Canonical ID for the user (for ACLs).
